name: Evergreen Support
description: Done-for-you customer-support email team for small online sellers / online businesses, billed monthly or weekly ("Start onboarding for $1", free support audit). Founded Jul 2022, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$25,100 MRR, 22 active subscriptions, ~$23,175 L30, ~$812,808 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 5, 2026 ~04:06 Warsaw (02:06 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Productize support for one platform's sellers (Shopify PL, Allegro, Etsy) with fixed weekly pricing plus your own helpdesk tooling. Software is leverage; the retainer is the business.

whyItPrints: Productized service, inbox outsourcing. 22 clients paying ~$1.1k/mo each on average (my calculation from MRR ÷ subs) adds up to ~$25k MRR and ~$813k all-time. Nobody wants to answer "where's my order?" emails, and once a team knows your store's macros, switching is painful.
whyThisMatters:
Small shops and software companies hand the support inbox to a US team. Evergreen answers customer email on weekdays and says a reply goes out within 24 hours. They write down your processes and tell you when the same complaint keeps showing up.

Staff cover each other's holidays and sick days, so someone is in the inbox every business day. Emma Fletcher and Ellis Annichine started it after a startup they shared closed in 2021. The replies come from people. If you ask for a chatbot, or a very cheap desk overseas, they say they'll point you somewhere else.

Onboarding starts with a tiny charge and a free look at the support you already run. After that the bill is a monthly or weekly retainer. The company is in the US and started in July 2022.
